correctness.rationale: The published degree/deletion lemmas and N(m+4,6,m)=m+16 theorem give the lower bound m+18. An explicit (15,28,6,10) code satisfies every restricted Hall inequality through request size six by exact exhaustive verification, and singleton extension propagates it to all m>=10.

originality.rationale: The checked exact-value literature reaches N(m+3,6,m) and N(m+4,6,m), while the later ordinary-CBC continuation located treats k=5. Searches for the exact formula, base parameters, Hall-equivalent formulations, a 2023 survey, and later generalized-CBC work found no statement of N(m+5,6,m)=m+18. The inaccessible full text of the 2026 generalized-CBC paper remains a documented residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem determines a new infinite exact diagonal for ordinary combinatorial batch codes at k=6 and provides a compact 10-server base construction that is independently checkable.
